summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund filed an 8-K to report entry into an Amended and Restated Expense Limitation and Reimbursement Agreement with its investment adviser, expanding expense support. The agreement allows the adviser to make voluntary expense payments for specified costs, recoupable over three years from excess operating funds. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. This is a routine contractual amendment between a BDC and its adviser, not a special event.
